digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify workflow - full-route job cancellation
propositions: Full-route jobs with always() predicates are not canceled when a superseding patchset arrives because GitHub re-evaluates predicates during cancellation and those conditions remain true.
Stale full-route matrix and reusable jobs consume runner resources (1,785 seconds in the evidence run) and delay successor job creation (1,510 seconds observed) after a replacement workflow exists.
The cancellation fix must preserve the docs-only fallback contract: classifier failure while not canceled must still launch the full-route fallback and remain blocking.

Replacing the leading always() with !cancelled() status checks in seven full-route job predicates will make those jobs ineligible when the run is canceled while preserving all other route eligibility conditions.
The regression test oracle must be RED before the fix (asserting stale jobs remain eligible under always() during cancellation) and GREEN after (asserting !cancelled() makes them ineligible).
Live evidence from the first genuine same-change replacement post-merge must demonstrate prompt cancellation of the superseded run without claiming wall-clock improvement to successful-run averages.
